content.text: {"notes":["The requested readout time is the absolute simulation time t = 1.0 s; joint angles are unwrapped and expressed in radians in each joint’s local frame.","Joint angular velocities are in rad/s in the corresponding joint-local frames, while the tip position is a world-frame vector in metres.","Both joints receive a constant applied torque of 0.4465595414874084 N·m; joint_1 additionally receives +0.5 N·m on the scheduled half-open interval [0.4987, 0.5987) s.","joint_limit_by_T indicates whether either joint has reached an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by the requested time; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
